scope: fixed held-out functional ablation and two-step conserved-pool fatigue toggle
inputs: same registered A and B validation streams, first 4096 targets in each; no training or updates
groups: for each of two blocks, ablate 8 contiguous pre-GELU ff1 activations; 16 disjoint groups per block, 32 total
intervention: zero the selected ff1 output group via a temporary inference hook, leaving all other model and optimizer state unchanged
measurement: byte-weighted BPB difference versus intact checkpoint on the same validation batches, independently for A and B
purpose: observe heterogeneous and domain-dependent functional contribution under intervention, not claim learned functions, causal mechanism path, or scale-general diversity
analysis: report all paired group effects; compare average absolute effect and effective number of groups, avoid tuning on this diagnostic
limitations: fresh validation samples are held out from training but not an untouched test set
additional_probe: from conserved-fatigue completed checkpoint, compare two identical held-out batches with conserved depletion toggled; row+column+pool total must be conserved in each closed update
